fact: The National Cybersecurity Policy 2022-2026 (revised September 2022) says government shall ensure development of a standard business continuity and recovery management framework (BCP), and a National Cybersecurity Contingency Plan for recovery after major incidents.
title: The National Cybersecurity Policy of The Gambia 2022-2026 (Revised Version)
publisher: Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy (The Gambia)
